item.title: A prize you both get if you both finish
item.summary: When you and a friend have both done every day late in a game, Murph offers in your group chat to add a prize you both get if you both finish. One of you names it and the other says yes.
item.details: It sits beside the game's prize or dare, and it lapses if either of you misses a day. Murph offers once per game, in the morning, in two-player games with a group chat. You can also ask Murph to add one yourselves.
